mcp_tools.name: lean4_formal_proof
mcp_tools.title: Lean4 formal proof
mcp_tools.description: Submit a declared Lean 4 proof-artifact manifest (project setup, statement integrity, definitions, proof integrity, theorem declarations, build attestation, model alignment); get a deterministic VERIFIED / NOT_VERIFIED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across seven sections, including computed zero-sorry, standard-axioms-only and kernel-checked theorem checks, with per-check evidence. Audits declared evidence; it does not run Lean or prove theorems.

inputSchema.description: The Lean 4 proof-artifact manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and theorems[] schema).

setup.description: Project-setup evidence (toolchain pinned, CI lake build, build green).

statements.description: Statement-integrity evidence (stated before proving, not weakened silently).

proof.description: Proof-integrity evidence (structured, cheating items tracked, none smuggled).

theorems.description: Declared theorems: {name, sorry_count, axioms, native_decide, kernel_checked}.

attestation.description: Build-attestation evidence (build log, axiom audit, reproduction recipe).

alignment.description: Model-alignment evidence (mapping documented, model/implementation in sync).

expect.notes: All boolean requirements met; theorems list valid; computed_spot_checks: theorems_evaluated=1, theorems_with_sorry=0
